projects.title: Chrono Isles

devLog.challenge: Handling object state changes between multiple timelines.
devLog.solution: Created an event-driven state management system for synchronized timeline updates.

projects.description: Chrono Isles is a third-person puzzle adventure prototype developed in Unreal Engine 5 using a hybrid workflow of C++ and Blueprint Visual Scripting. The project features a custom third-person character controller written in C++, while gameplay systems, puzzle logic, and interactive environments were built using Blueprints. Players explore a chain of floating islands where each level introduces mechanics such as Time Manipulation, Teleportation, Dynamic Gravity, and Electricity, culminating in puzzles that combine multiple abilities. This project showcases my skills in gameplay programming, system design, level design, and creating modular gameplay mechanics.

projects.title: Haunted Village
projects.description: Haunted Village Prototype is a first-person horror prototype developed to demonstrate AI behavior, stealth mechanics, and atmospheric horror gameplay. Players explore an abandoned village where opening a mysterious box transforms the environment from day to night, unleashing supernatural entities. The objective is to locate and destroy five cursed tape recorders while avoiding ghosts and environmental traps. The prototype focuses on creating suspense through enemy AI and immersive horror elements.

projects.title: Dual Worlds
projects.description: Dual Worlds is a first-person puzzle adventure developed in Unreal Engine. Players explore two interconnected worlds—a Day World and a Night World—linked by a mysterious portal. Every action performed in one world directly affects the other, creating unique environmental puzzles that require observation, logic, and exploration. The objective is to collect three ancient stones, each unlocked through a different puzzle. Players manipulate the environment across worlds, possess and control mirrors to redirect beams of light, and use a weight machine to identify object weights before balancing an ancient mechanism. By switching between the Day and Night Worlds, players solve interconnected puzzles and uncover the path to the final objective.

projects.title: 10-Second Escape
projects.description: 0-Second Escape is a fast-paced level-based puzzle prototype developed in Unreal Engine. The player is trapped inside a closed room and must escape within a strict 10-second time limit. Each level features a unique room layout where the player must quickly find a hidden key and reach the locked door before time runs out. The short time constraint creates high tension gameplay focused on speed, observation, and quick decision-making.As levels progress, room layouts become more complex, with smarter key placements and tighter navigation spaces, increasing the challenge while keeping the core mechanic simple and replayable.

projects.title: Village Platformer
projects.description: A 3D side-view platformer set in a peaceful village environment where players navigate through platforms, obstacles, and walls using precise movement and jumping mechanics. The game features a unique camera transition system that smoothly rotates to a new side-view perspective whenever the player reaches the edge of a wall, creating seamless navigation between different paths while maintaining intuitive platforming gameplay.

projects.title: Tank Battle Prototype
projects.description: A tank combat prototype developed to demonstrate core vehicle movement and combat mechanics. The player controls a tank, navigates the battlefield, and destroys enemy tanks using projectile-based weapons. Enemy tanks automatically fire when the player enters their attack range. The prototype focuses on implementing responsive controls, shooting mechanics, and range-based enemy attack behavior.

projects.title: One More Death
projects.description: One More Death is a 2D puzzle-platformer developed in Unity that challenges players to solve platforming puzzles using a unique sacrifice mechanic. Instead of avoiding death, players must strategically use it to overcome obstacles. By sacrificing the character, a platform is created at the death location, allowing the player to build new paths and reach the portal. Featuring a minimalist black-and-white art style with red hazards, the game focuses on creative puzzle-solving, precision platforming, and strategic thinking.

projects.title: Bros's Jump

devLog.challenge: Designing puzzles that require both characters' unique abilities while keeping gameplay balanced and engaging.
devLog.solution: Created levels where players must combine the Double Jump and Wall Jump mechanics to solve environmental puzzles and reach the exit portal together.
devLog.impact: Delivered fun cooperative puzzle gameplay with increasing difficulty, encouraging strategic thinking, teamwork, and replayability across multiple levels.

projects.description: Bros's Jump is a 2D cooperative puzzle platformer where players control two unique characters, each with different movement abilities. One character can perform a Double Jump, while the other can Wall Jump. Players must work together to overcome obstacles, avoid traps, collect coins, and reach the exit portal to complete each level.
mechanics: Two playable characters with unique abilities
Character 1 uses Double Jump to reach high platforms
Character 2 uses Wall Jump to climb vertical surfaces
Collect coins hidden throughout each level
Reach portal with both characters to exit

projects.title: Color Triangle
projects.description: Color Triangle is a fast-paced arcade game developed in Unity where players rotate a three-sided colored triangle to match incoming colored balls. The game combines simple controls with increasingly challenging gameplay, encouraging quick reflexes and precise timing. Designed for Android and Web platforms, the project showcases gameplay programming, responsive controls, UI implementation, and game systems.
mechanics: mooth rotation using Unity Input System

projects.title: Candy Wire Gyro

devLog.challenge: Creating smooth and responsive gyroscope controls while supporting traditional button controls, and designing a polished candy-themed UI that works well across different mobile screen sizes.
devLog.solution: Implemented dual control modes (Gyroscope and Button), optimized collision detection, built a reusable UI management system with DOTween animations, and designed a responsive level system using a single-scene architecture.
devLog.impact: Delivered a polished hyper-casual prototype featuring responsive controls, smooth UI transitions, scalable level progression, and an engaging candy-themed visual style optimized for mobile devices.

projects.description: Candy Wire Gyro is a hyper-casual precision game where players guide a metal loop through a twisting candy-shaped wire without touching it. Players can choose between Gyroscope Control or Button Control, making the game accessible on different mobile devices. The objective is to carefully navigate through each obstacle-filled level while avoiding collisions and reaching the finish point. The game features colorful candy-themed visuals, simple one-touch gameplay, multiple handcrafted levels, and smooth controls designed for quick and enjoyable play sessions.
mechanics: Precision wire navigation without touching obstacles
Dual control modes (Gyroscope or Button input)
Particle and sound effect feedback for collisions
Candy-themed UI with animated menus using DOTween
features: Dual input control system (Gyro & Touch Buttons)

projects.title: Gyro Ball Prototype

devLog.challenge: Creating smooth and responsive gyroscope controls while maintaining realistic physics-based ball movement across different maze environments.
devLog.solution: Implemented Unity's gyroscope input with physics-driven Rigidbody movement, combined with optimized camera follow, collision handling, and mobile-friendly UI for an intuitive gameplay experience.
devLog.impact: Delivered a natural and immersive motion-control experience with stable performance, responsive gameplay, and a scalable level system suitable for expanding into a complete mobile game.

projects.description: Gyro Ball Prototype is a real-time motion-controlled experience designed for mobile devices. The player guides a ball through a 3D environment using only device tilt input. The objective is to maintain balance, control speed, and navigate through different surfaces and obstacles. The prototype focuses on testing intuitive gyro-based movement combined with Unity physics for realistic rolling behavior.
mechanics: Device rotation is mapped to world-space force or torque applied to the ball
Uses Unity New Input System for gyro data handling.
Surface angle affects speed and direction.

projects.title: Zombie Land

devLog.challenge: Creating an endless zombie survival system with smooth performance on both mobile and PC.
devLog.solution: Built a wave-based spawning system, headshot/body-shot damage, and cross-platform controls using Unity's New Input System.
devLog.impact: Delivered smooth FPS gameplay, scalable endless waves, and responsive controls across mobile and PC.

projects.description: Zombie Land is a first-person survival shooter prototype where the player drops into a zombie-infested battlefield using a parachute and must survive against endless waves of enemies. Zombies spawn randomly around the map and continuously hunt the player, creating intense and fast-paced survival gameplay. The player is equipped with firearms and grenades to eliminate incoming zombies. The main objective is to survive as long as possible in an infinite wave system where difficulty gradually increases over time.
mechanics: Hit detection for body and headshots
Headshots deal higher damage than body shots

projects.title: Car Color Path

devLog.challenge: Creating a smooth one-touch control system where the car moves while the screen is held, stops instantly when released, and paints the road accurately without affecting gameplay.
devLog.solution: Implemented a touch-and-hold movement system with real-time path painting, obstacle detection, car selection, and smoke particle effects to provide responsive controls and visual feedback.
devLog.impact: Delivered smooth and intuitive gameplay with satisfying visual effects, improved player control, and a polished casual game experience suitable for mobile devices.

projects.description: Car Color Path is a casual arcade prototype inspired by path-painting mechanics. The player controls a car that drives along a predefined track and paints the road while moving. The main objective is to complete the entire level by coloring the full path while avoiding moving obstacles. The game focuses on simple one-touch control, smooth movement, and satisfying visual feedback.

projects.title: Land Shark
projects.description: Land Shark is a third-person action prototype developed in Unity. Players control a shark that swims through the ocean and hunts human swimmers using fast-paced, physics-based attack mechanics. The prototype focuses on creating responsive movement, intelligent target selection, and dynamic shark attack behavior.
